## Research status

**Technical owners.** 3 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Cognitive Compilation and Semantic IR](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/cognitive-compilation-and-semantic-ir.html), [Relational Dimension Compilation and Polyadic Cognition](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/relational-dimension-compilation-and-polyadic-cognition.html), [Mathematical and Search Substrates](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/mathematical-and-search-substrates.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 7.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** End-to-end systems preserving intent, relational roles, and recovery better without explicit IR would narrow the compilation boundary.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
